content:
rachel: Kicking off tidepool-13b onboarding. short smoke run results and checklist so we don't miss pre-prod gotchas.
sam: Thanks — quick ask: prioritization? is this high for Dedicated pool?
rachel: It's mid-high. dev customers asked for lower-cost variant. goal: validate int8 perf + quality baseline before dedicated capacity signoff.
miguel: I ran a tiny sweep overnight. initial numbers: fp16 p50 40ms, p95 110ms, throughput 420 tok/s @bs16, ctx 2048. int8 roughly 1.9x throughput, p95 up ~15ms.
priya: can you paste the exact bench command?
miguel: sure:
```
bench-run --model tidepool-13b --precision fp16 --bs 16 --ctx 2048 --seq 256 --out tidepool_fp16_2048.json
bench-run --model tidepool-13b --precision int8 --bs 16 --ctx 2048 --seq 256 --out tidepool_int8_2048.json
```
rachel: nice. did you run warmup / kv prefilling?
miguel: yes 50 warmup requests, coldstart profiles too. cold p50 about 150ms, warm p50 40ms.
bench-bot: Automated check: throughput >= 350 tok/s? PASS. latency p95 <= 150ms? PASS for fp16, marginal for int8.
priya: quality side — eval set WER/ROUGE on safety and instruction-following?
miguel: ran eval-bot on our 2k prompt subset. int8 BLEURT delta -0.02 vs fp16 (small), ROUGE ~same. but a small failure mode on long code formatting prompts.
eval-bot: Full eval report: https://intra/reports/tidepool-13b/3629001111 (summary: 98.6% pass on core tests, 93.4% on long-format code prompts)
sam: That long-format regression is concerning for a code assistant customer. Can we reproduce with different quant backend?
miguel: I will try qint8 + per-channel quant next. adding to checklist.
rachel: Checklist (actionable): 1) run ctx sweep 512/1024/2048/4096 with bs 8/16 for fp16+int8; 2) run end-to-end eval set (full 10k prompts) for quality regression; 3) verify KV cache correctness with multi-turn sessions; 4) warmup strategy docs; 5) create canary config for Dedicated.
sam: add: measure memory footprint and OOM edgecases (esp for ctx 4096).
priya: I'll own quality evals (10k). target: delta BLEURT < -0.05.
miguel: I'll own perf sweeps and quant backend triage. starting now, ETA EOD tomorrow.
rachel: I'll draft the canary rollout config and SLA notes.
bench-bot: Scheduled job created: tidepool-perf-sweep-3629001111 at 2026-03-22T02:00Z
sam: If int8 persists with code-format regressions, fallback plan: ship fp16 as default in Dedicated and offer int8 opt-in with warning.
priya: Also will run hallucination/regression evals on instruction-robustness set.
miguel: quick note: observed small tokenization differences vs our tokenizer v2, adding a test case.
rachel: perfect. let's reconvene after full sweep. if any blocker showstopper, ping #eng-oncall. :eyes:
sam: thanks all — good progress. :thumbsup:
